title: eMMC host: CMD0 / CMD1 (busy polling) / CMD2 / CMD3 initialisation, then repeated CMD24 write and CMD17 read-back compare rounds in 1-bit mode, with R1 / R2 / R3 framing, CRC7, card-status, CRC16, CRC status token, busy and timeout checks

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a response, CRC status, busy or read phase failed (framing, CRC7, command index, card-status error bits, timeout, negative or missing CRC status, busy timeout, read CRC16 / end bit / compare); the host retries

notes: The core runs on PCLK as its eMMC bus clock (1 bit per PCLK); its unused system clock input is tied off. cmd and dat[7:0] (bidirectional, need pull-ups; only DAT0 is used) and emmc_rst_n (device reset, combined with PRESETN) pass through unchanged. The host initialises the device and runs its write / read-back rounds on its own.
Blocks are 32 bytes (the slice's simplification of 512).
